name: Improved Poison (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite: Ability to deliver poison from a natural attack, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit: The damage (hit point or ability) for the creature’s poison increases by one step using the following progression: 1, 1d2, 1d3, 1d4, 1d6, 1d8, 2d6, 2d8, 4d6, 6d6, 8d6, 12d6.

Special: Poisons that do not deal damage or drain are unaffected by this feat.
